dedupe_keys.name: ctu open data catalogue czech telecommunication office datasets on markets spectrum coverage and quality

description: The Czech Telecommunication Office (ČTÚ) runs its own open data catalogue on the DKAN platform, which held 105 datasets when listed. They are grouped into electronic communications market indicators, spectrum management, postal market indicators, consumer protection and inspection, finance, staff, administrative acts and other data. Telecom groups include economic indicators and statistics for fixed, mobile and broadcasting markets, numbers of broadband connections, number portability, retail and wholesale prices, lists of authorised providers, coverage of the country by next-generation access (30 Mbit/s and above) and 100 Mbit/s infrastructure by basic settlement unit and region, and quality-of-service mapping. Spectrum datasets list valid licences and technical data for television and radio transmitters with antenna patterns, fixed service equipment and antennas, point-to-point links at 71 to 86 GHz, frequency assignments, amateur, aeronautical and maritime stations, DAB+ service identifiers and spectrum use. Inspection datasets include measured mobile coverage of motorways and railway corridors, stationary 2G and 4G signal measurements, radio interference investigations, fines and complaints, and NetTest crowdsourced speed tests. Coverage: Czechia. Format and access: CSV and XLSX files, some ZIP and JSON, with a CKAN-compatible API, free under ČTÚ terms that allow commercial reuse with attribution. Caveats: many price and market series stopped being updated around 2023; descriptions are in Czech. Simulation uses: network inventory, coverage and demand inputs for Czech telecom and broadcast models. Related records: the ČTÚ broadband coverage, mobile measurement, transmitter and NetTest records describe key datasets, and CESNET traffic data cover the research network.
